title: trackerSessionNames
responsibility: Builds the tmux-safe "Project: title" session label and recognizes hand-launched sessions named for an item.

inputs.name: trackerSessionLabel.item
inputs.description: Item title with its project or agent.

inputs.name: trackerSessionLabel.fallback
inputs.description: Prefix used when the item has no project or agent.

inputs.name: trackerSessionNames.item
inputs.description: Item id, title, owner and project or agent.

inputs.name: trackerHandSession.windows
inputs.description: Observed tmux session and window name pairs.

inputs.name: trackerHandSession.item
inputs.description: Item id, title, owner and project or agent.

outputs.name: trackerSessionLabel
outputs.description: "Project: title", at most 80 characters, safe as a tmux window name.

outputs.name: trackerSessionNames
outputs.description: Normalized names a hand-launched session for the item may carry.

outputs.name: trackerHandSession
outputs.description: Whether a session not owned by the launcher is named for the item.
